mapper.insert: INSERT INTO byai.agent_capability_cards (system_code, agent_id, agent_code, agent_name, schema_version, generator_version, source_version, source_fingerprint, card, routing_text, quality, status, version, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{entity.systemCode}, #{entity.agentId}, #{entity.agentCode}, #{entity.agentName}, #{entity.schemaVersion}, #{entity.generatorVersion}, #{entity.sourceVersion}, #{entity.sourceFingerprint}, #{entity.card}, #{entity.routingText}, #{entity.quality}, COALESCE(#{entity.status}, 'ACTIVE'), 0, COALESCE(#{entity.createdAt}, NOW()), COALESCE(#{entity.updatedAt}, NOW())) ON CONFLICT (system_code, agent_id) DO UPDATE SET agent_code = EXCLUDED.agent_code, agent_name = EXCLUDED.agent_name, schema_version = EXCLUDED.schema_version, generator_version = EXCLUDED.generator_version, source_version = EXCLUDED.source_version, source_fingerprint = EXCLUDED.source_fingerprint, card = EXCLUDED.card, routing_text = EXCLUDED.routing_text, quality = EXCLUDED.quality, status = 'ACTIVE', version = agent_capability_cards.version + 1, updated_at = COALESCE(EXCLUDED.updated_at, NOW())
